Inspect and control live audio conferences

Usage:
  plivo voice conferences [flags]
  plivo voice conferences [command]

Aliases:
  conferences, conf, conference

Available Commands:
  get         Get conference details (members, run time)
  hangup      End the entire conference (requires --yes)
  list        List active conference names
  member      Per-member actions inside a conference
  record      Start recording a conference
  stop-record Stop the active recording on a conference

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for conferences

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo voice conferences [command] --help" for more information about a command.
